methodology.enumeration: Real spaces sourced from operator sites, Coworker.com, CoworkingCafe, Spaces/Regus & WeWork directories, cross-verified against a second source. Unknown attributes left null — never fabricated.
methodology.digitalScore: Multi-signal score from a live headless-Chromium render (re-scanned 2026-06-25). Seven graded dimensions, weighted: security/HTTPS (12), performance — load time + request count (20), mobile incl. no-horizontal-overflow (15), SEO depth — title/meta quality, canonical, structured data (18), social & shareability — Open Graph, Twitter card, profile count (12), conversion — booking + contact (13), content & freshness — word count, image alt coverage, blog, copyright year (10). Graded continuously, so it spreads 0-100 and no longer saturates.
methodology.limits: This scores web PRESENCE/quality, not the quality of the space itself. Performance is measured headless (no network throttling) so it reflects relative, not absolute, speed. Booking/social/contact detection is heuristic and can miss non-standard widgets. National-chain location pages (Regus/Spaces) now score on their real per-page signals (content-heavy, fast — so B-range), not an artifact. Google ratings are sparse (not metered-API-pulled, to avoid cost). 3 independent domains did not resolve via DNS on scan day. Coordinates geocoded from addresses (some at neighborhood/city precision).
